architecture_observations: The canonical pnpm test command is an orchestrator, not a unit-only shortcut: it invokes the root Vitest stage and then every filtered workspace test sequentially, stopping on the first nonzero result.

The runner uses fixed argument arrays and shell:false, forwards process streams, and maps spawn errors or signal termination to a failing exit status. It has no timeout or explicit child cancellation policy.
The contract test proves orchestration semantics only; it does not prove test-suite side-effect safety or DB behavior.
The changed main CI workflow explicitly runs lint and typecheck as separate jobs, while other checked-in workflows invoke other test subsets. No remote workflow was dispatched.

findings_and_limits.observation: The canonical pnpm test command runs root Vitest followed by all workspace tests. The orchestrator itself is deterministic, but it does not guard against the configured database-aware setup/hooks in those suites.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Keep broad local test commands held until an approved disposable database target or no-connection guard is available; the isolated contract test does not authorize the aggregate run.
